answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1234 Country: Pakistan Title: What is about takaful (Islamic insurance) concept? Is it Halal? Question: What is about takaful (Islamic insurance) concept? Is it Halal? Answer ID: 1234 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 244=339/D) It is allowed to take guarantee of ones wealth and life. There is an entire chapter of Kifalah in Islamic Fiqh books. As far as Takaful (Islamic Insurance) is concerned what are its features and other conditions? Please, explain the nature of this concept, then we shall have a say in the matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
